name: Crystals Carved from Stone
source:
Crystal is the owner of The Cavern, a local crystal shop built in an abandoned mine under the city. Billie enjoys dragging Crystal into her schemes, especially because Crystal has enough common sense to keep them out of trouble.

[From [url=https://banana-ooyu.itch.io/one-just-night]itch.io[/url]]
